svg.title: Weight change after stopping tirzepatide, three studies
svg.desc: Weight change after stopping tirzepatide, three studies. SURMOUNT-4: stayed on tirzepatide, 52 weeks · Lilly trial, 335 people: -5.5%. SURMOUNT-4: switched to placebo, 52 weeks · Lilly trial, 335 people: +14.0%. REMAIN-1 Midpoint: sham, 12 months · 16 people, not powered: +13.0%. REMAIN-1 Midpoint: Revita, 12 months · 29 people, not powered: +7.8%. REMAIN-1 Pivotal: sham, 6 months · 74 people with Week 26 weight: +8.2%. REMAIN-1 Pivotal: Revita, 6 months · 176 people with Week 26 weight: +5.1%.
